title: Boolean function circuit gadget
statement: For a nonnegative integer $m$ and a Boolean function $f:\{0,1\}^m\to\{0,1\}$, the gadget is the directed acyclic circuit on $m$ input vertices obtained by converting the universal circuit for $f$ to a directed acyclic graph and binarizing it.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on $m$ Boolean inputs
caveat: The snippet does not define the universal-circuit conversion or binarization constructions, so their precise conventions are not specified.
